verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents a fast path to taking payments online. Accounts open in minutes from a phone (docs-33), and a payment link can be generated in the app or website and shared without building a site (docs-5). A hosted checkout redirect (docs-4) supports guest payment without a Mercado Pago account (docs-14), 3DS 2.0 card authentication (docs-16) and card-data handling (docs-9). The 'within a day' timing is implied by these pieces rather than stated outright. Missing for 10: documented merchant verification/activation timeline before payments can be accepted, explicit confirmation that payment links accept cards, independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day first payment.
